interfaces.mounting: Male spline: chassis/flange support required. Do not hang on coupling/output shaft.
interfaces.spline: DIN 5480 nominal 55 mm, module 3, 17 teeth; full OEM mating definition required

load_request.notes: 300 bar study point; 450 bar catalog ceiling, not released relief. 1.5 multiplier is a sensitivity, not an approved shock factor. Final load spectrum includes reversing, braking, faults and fatigue.

mechanical_decision: Axle-following flange carrier is a development requirement. Support and torque path not yet designed; do not combine a rigid guided carrier and independent rigid reaction link without kinematic analysis.
